AccessToken.description: What may be shown of an access token; the secret is shown once, at creation.

Agent.description: An agent an organization may run: a model and the harness around it.

builtIn.description: Offered because the organization has set none up yet; an owner's own list replaces it.

enabled.description: Auto chooses only among the agents that are turned on.

id.description: A lower-case slug such as `claude-code`; sessions name it.

isDefault.description: What Auto uses before it has data; an owner sets it, and it is never set by brand.

oneOf.description: The card's own fields. `None` only for a card raised before payloads existed.

summary.description: What would happen; never a secret.

AuditEntry.description: An append-only record of a write or an approval. Holds no secret.

action.description: A registered action name, such as `session.start`.

target.description: The id of what it touched.

AuditPage.description: Newest first; `next` is the cursor for the page after this one.

AutoChoice.description: The agent Auto would start, and why in one line.

BudgetSummary.description: This month's spend against the caps.

nowCents.description: The session's budget when the card was raised.

branch.description: `None`: the agent pushes to a branch of its own.

allOf.description:
A change to the environment the session runs on, in full: what the agent asked for, the
environment as it was and as it would be. It holds no network secret value.

oneOf.description:
A change to the environment the session runs on, in full: what the agent asked for, the
environment as it was and as it would be. It holds no network secret value.
The agent asked to use a tool that is set to ask first.

detail.description: What it would do, as the harness described it.

permission.description: The harness's id for the ask; the answer goes back under it.

oneOf.description: A connector's tool set to "ask first". The digest names the one input approved.

CardPayload.description:
What each kind of card asks, as typed fields. A card shows these, never text parsed out of
its summary, and an action that follows an approval reads what to do from here.

CommitInfo.description: One commit made since the base.

time.description: When it was committed, epoch milliseconds.

Connector.description: A remote MCP server. The credential is kept sealed on the server and never shown.

name.description: Also the prefix of its tools' names in a session: `<slug>__<tool>`.

ConnectorHealth.description: Never shown as healthy before it was checked.

ContextPart.description: One measured part of the latest model request, in tokens.

ContextPartKind.description: What a part of a model request is made of.

CostTier.description: "$", "$$" or "$$$", set from the agent's price.

Environment.description:
One version of an environment an organization manages, or the built-in default. A change
makes a new version; a session records the version it ran.

allowedHosts.description: Exact host names; used at the limited level.

builtIn.description: The default every organization has; it is not stored and cannot be changed.

createdAt.description: When this version was made, in milliseconds.

oneOf.description: Who made this version; empty for the built-in default.

networkSecrets.description: What the proxy adds to HTTPS requests to a host. Never a value (write-only).

repos.description: Default repos (`owner/repo`): a new session on this environment starts with them.

setupScript.description:
Runs as root in a fresh container after the repos are cloned, before the agent starts;
empty for none. A failing script does not fail the session.

variables.description: Plain variables, readable by the agent. Model keys never go here.

EnvironmentChange.description:
What an agent proposes to change in its session's environment. A field left out changes
nothing.

setupScript.description: The whole new script; an empty one removes it.

EnvironmentProposal.description: The body of a Change environment card.

baseVersion.description: The newest version now, which the change is applied to; the approval makes the next.

createsEnvironment.description:
The session is on the built-in default, which cannot change: approving makes a new
environment of its own and moves the session to it.

environment.description: The environment the session is on; `default` is the built-in one.

sessionVersion.description: The version the session runs on now, which `before` shows.

EnvironmentView.description:
What an environment holds that a session's own change can touch: the network, the variables,
the setup script and the default repos. Network secrets and the machine size are not here.

variables.description: Plain variables with their values, readable by the agent.

EventKind.description:
Who spoke: a person, an agent, the name of a tool an agent called, or an error the model's
provider or the machine reported.

EventPage.description: Oldest first. `next` is the `after` for the page that follows, or `null` when this is the end so far.

FileChange.description:
One file of a diff. `patch` is the unified diff text from its first `@@` line on, with
three lines of context; it is empty for a binary file and for one that is too large.

oldPath.description: The path before a rename; `null` otherwise.

FileStatus.description: How a file differs from the base.

Identity.description: A person's identity at a sign-in provider.

KindSpend.description: What one kind of spend came to.

defaultBudgetCents.description: The cap a new session gets when its request names none.

maxRunningSessions.description: Most sessions running on machines at once; omitted: unchanged.

oneOf.description:
First message of a connection. Refetch what you show: it may have changed while you
were away. `cursor` is the `seq` the stream continues from.
The server cannot replay what was missed. Refetch everything you show.
A conversation item was added to a session. Fetch `GET /sessions/{id}/events?after=`.
A runner reported a session's changes: refetch `GET /sessions/{id}/changes`.
A session's context use changed: refetch `GET /sessions/{id}/context`.
The cards waiting for this member changed; `pending` is how many wait now.

LiveEvent.description:
One message on `GET /events/stream`: a hint that something changed, so a client refetches
what it shows. It carries ids, a count and a status, never words, a card's text or any
secret. The SSE `event:` name is the kebab-case `type` and the `id:` is a conversation
`seq` (on `hello`, `resync` and `message`), which a reconnecting browser sends back as
`Last-Event-ID`.

Me.description:
Who is signed in: the member, their organization and their role in it, and every
organization the same identity belongs to.

role.description: Their organization role, which is their default in every project.

oneOf.description: A person has one; a service account has none.

role.description: The organization role, the default in every project.

ModelKeyStatus.description: Which providers an organization has a key for, and when it was last set. Never the key.

ModelProvider.description: A model provider whose key an organization brings. The proxy forwards to it unchanged.

NetworkLevel.description:
How much of the network a session's machine may reach (docs/V0.md, Environments). `None`
is no outbound traffic except the platform hosts (model gateway, MCP, code host); `Limited` is `allowed_hosts` plus package
registries when allowed; `Full` is any host except private, loopback and metadata addresses.

NetworkSecret.description:
A header the proxy adds to HTTPS requests to `host` from sessions in an environment, so the
value never enters the machine. The value is not part of this type: it is write-only.

prefix.description: Put before the value, such as `Bearer`; none when empty or left out.

NewAgent.description: What an owner sets for an agent.

credential.description: Sent to the server as a bearer token. Stored sealed; never returned.

NewEnvironment.description: What makes an environment, or a new version of one. The id comes from the name on create.

networkSecrets.description: On an edit, an entry without a `value` keeps the value the same host and header had.

variables.description: Readable by the agent: a service key goes here, a model key never does.

oneOf.description: A person's identity at a sign-in provider; none makes a service account.

NewModelKey.description: A key to set or replace. It is never returned.

NewNetworkSecret.description: A network secret a person writes: the value is sealed at once and never read back.

value.description: Left out on an edit to keep the stored value.

NewPlugin.description: The bundle an owner or editor adds: a manifest and its parts.

files.description: Text files; `SKILL.md` is required at the top. The name comes from its front matter.

oneOf.description: A service account to issue it for (owners only); omitted: the caller.

defaultBudgetCents.description: The cap a new session gets when its request names none, in US cents.

maxRunningSessions.description: Most sessions this organization has on machines at once; queued ones wait.

monthlyCapCents.description: Monthly cap on all spend, in US cents. `None`: no cap.

PluginConnector.description: A connector a plugin names. Its credential is added afterwards, on the connector.

PluginPart.description: What a plugin brought, by kind and name (a skill's name, a connector's id).

Policy.description: What policy does with one card kind. Add credential only ever asks.

defaultBudgetCents.description: Default budget per session, in US cents.

monthlyCapCents.description: Monthly cap on the spend of its sessions, in US cents.

ProjectRole.description: A member's role in one project when it differs from the organization role.

RemovePlugin.description: What to do with each part when a plugin is removed; a part not named is removed, and one in use refuses.

RepoChanges.description: One repo's changes, as the Changes panel reads them.

commits.description: Newest first. Each has its own diff at `GET /sessions/{id}/changes/commits/{sha}`.

files.description: All changes: the base against the working tree.

reportedAt.description: When the runner reported it, epoch milliseconds.

Role.description: Ordered: a higher role may do what a lower one may.

Session.description:
One agent's work in a project: a chat that runs in a machine of its own. The repos,
the environment version and the model are fixed when it starts.

budgetCapCents.description: What this session alone may spend, in US cents. `None`: only the organization's monthly cap.

createdBy.description: The member who started it; its calls and cards are theirs.

environment.description: The stored environment it runs on; `None` is the built-in default.

environmentVersion.description: The version of that environment, pinned when the session started.

followPolicy.description: The composer's Mode: false asks a person for every card, true lets policy approve.

note.description: Why it ended, such as "Stopped by Ada", or what went wrong when it failed.

SessionBudget.description: A session's own cap, in US cents.

SessionChanges.description: The latest report for each repo of the session; empty before the first one.

SessionContext.description:
A session's context window as the Overview reads it. A field the server has not been told
yet is `null` (or an empty list); a session that has made no call has all of them empty.

parts.description:
What the latest request was made of, scaled to the provider's own input count. Empty
until the gateway has measured one.

reportedAt.description: When anything last changed, epoch milliseconds; `null` before the first report.

used.description: Tokens the latest model call filled: input plus cache reads and writes.

window.description: The model's context window, in tokens.

SessionEnvironment.description: The environment to move a session to: its newest version.

environment.description: An environment's id; `default` is the built-in one.

SessionEvent.description:
One item of a session's conversation. A tool call carries what `ToolRecord` keeps, never more:
the server stores the words people and agents said and a short, cleaned record of each tool call.

oneOf.description: Who said it, for a person's message.

seq.description: Orders the conversation; a page is asked for by the last `seq` seen.

oneOf.description: What a tool call did; set only when `kind` is `tool`, and absent on calls recorded before it existed.

SessionIssued.description: A sign-in session; the secret is shown once and is also set as a cookie.

SessionSpend.description:
All the spend of one session since it began, against its own cap, if it has one. Spend rows
name a session and a kind.

SetProjectRole.description: `None` returns the member to their organization role in this project.

oneOf.description:
Left out, the person's organizations are found from their identity: the oldest
membership signs in, and `GET /me` lists the rest.

SkillFile.description: One text file of a skill pack, by path inside its folder.

SkillVersion.description: One immutable version of an organization skill.

StartSession.description: What starts a session in a project: `POST /projects/{id}/sessions`.

agent.description: Left out or `auto`: the agent Auto chooses.

budgetCapCents.description: This session's own cap in US cents; left out, the project's default, then the organization's.

followPolicy.description: The composer's Mode: false asks a person for every card, true lets policy approve.

model.description: `provider/model`; left out, the server's default model.

title.description: Left out, the first line of the prompt.

TokenIssued.description: An access token; the secret is shown once.

ToolMode.description: What a session may do with one tool of a connector.

ToolRecord.description:
What one tool call did, kept small: a short label (the first line of a command, a file path,
the Antilog tool's name), how it ended, and its input and output cut to 4 KB each with
anything that looks like a credential taken out.

ToolStatus.description: How a tool call ended. A call still running is not stored: it is recorded when it ends.
